install.title: Keep World Zero in your pocket
install.bodyAndroid: Install it like an app: its own icon, the whole screen, no browser bars. Same game, same account, same you.
install.bodyIphone: iPhones don't have an install button, so it takes three taps. It's also the only way an iPhone can get World Zero notifications.

steps.2: Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen
steps.3: Tap Add, then open World Zero from its new icon

install.once: We only ask once. Not now means not now, forever.
